description: Search for a venue by name, then get the user's check-in stats at the top match (1 search call + a scan of the user's recent check-in feed at 25/page)

max_pages.description: Max feed pages to scan at 25 check-ins/page (default 5 = 125 check-ins)

username.description: Untappd username (defaults to UNTAPPD_USERNAME env var)

name: search_venue_then_get_user_stats
